overall: Board violated the OML by failing to approve its November 21, 2013 minutes in a timely manner (not intentional); no violation on minutes accuracy; December 19 allegation declined as untimely; no further relief ordered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the November 21, 2013 meeting minutes were inaccurate and lacked sufficient detail.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, because these minutes remained in draft form at the time of this complaint, we find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by creating inaccurate or insufficiently detailed minutes.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the December 19, 2013 meeting minutes were inaccurate and lacked sufficient detail; filed too late to be reviewed.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review the allegation concerning the December 19, 2013 meeting minutes because it is untimely.

allegations.summary: The Board did not approve its November 21, 2013 minutes until six months after the meeting, which the AG reviewed as a timeliness question under the minutes approval requirement.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the Board failed to approve its November 21, 2013 meeting minutes in a timely manner because it did not approve those minutes until six months after that meeting.
